hardware.gpu_allocation: one NVIDIA HX00 GPU per independent GPU task

method: The primary totals sum training_runtime_seconds from all 45 accepted arm metrics and evaluation_runtime_seconds from the accepted baseline. Robustness totals sum total_evaluation_time_seconds from all 46 accepted profile results.
scope_warning: These are exact recorded runtimes for successful scientific workloads, not scheduler allocation accounting. They exclude model-loading time before each internal timer, preparation, analysis, finalizers, operational smoke tests, and failed or superseded allocations, so they are a lower bound on total project compute.
